---
title: "lucid-writer"
subtitle: "Make research writing clearer without making the evidence stronger than it is"
toc: false
---

lucid-writer is an Agent Skill for Claude Code and Codex. It edits, drafts and reviews research articles, reports, abstracts and reviewer responses. It scales from a two-sentence copyedit to a full manuscript audit.

Generic rewriting tends to turn an association into a cause while it polishes the prose. lucid-writer checks every material claim against its evidence before it changes the wording:

```text
claim → evidence → scope → uncertainty → inference ceiling → wording
```

Its priorities run in this order, and a lower one never wins at the cost of a higher one:

1. Evidence integrity
2. Argument
3. Reader comprehension
4. Concision
5. Surface polish

## Before and after

Input:

> Interestingly, participants with higher baseline CD161+ CD4 T-cell frequencies showed a significantly delayed time to parasitaemia (HR 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.95, p=0.018). Taken together, these findings demonstrate that CD161+ CD4 T cells play a crucial protective role against malaria infection.

lucid-writer:

> Higher baseline CD161+ CD4 T-cell frequencies were associated with delayed parasitaemia (HR 0.72, 95% CI 0.55–0.95; p=0.018). This association is consistent with a relationship between this phenotype and parasite control but does not establish a causal protective role.

The numbers survive; the causal claim the data cannot carry does not. More cases are on the [Evaluation](evaluation.qmd) page.

## Install

### Claude Code plugin

The plugin loads the skill and the three review subagents:

```text
/plugin marketplace add mdmanurung/lucid-writer
/plugin install lucid-writer@lucid-writer
```

### Installer script

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer
cd lucid-writer
bash scripts/install.sh both        # Claude Code and Codex
```

On Windows, run `.\scripts\install.ps1 both`. Use `claude` or `codex` instead of `both` for one target. The installer copies `skills/lucid-writer/` and the three review subagents. Add `--skill-only` after the target to skip the subagents (PowerShell: `-SkillOnly`). It replaces any installed copy and makes no network requests.

Use the plugin or the installer, not both: together they load two copies of the skill.

### By hand

Copy `skills/lucid-writer/` to `~/.claude/skills/lucid-writer` (Claude Code) or `~/.agents/skills/lucid-writer` (Codex). For a skill scoped to one repository, copy it to `.agents/skills/` there. The Codex plugin manifest ships the skill only; `install.sh codex` adds the subagents. Without Git, use **Code → Download ZIP** on GitHub and copy the same folder.

### Verify

Start a new session and paste:

```text
Use lucid-writer to tighten this paragraph without changing claim strength:
[paste a research paragraph]
```

Then check that it triggers on its own:

```text
Review this Discussion for overclaiming, missing alternatives, and unnecessary repetition.
```

### Update and uninstall

To update, run `git pull`, then rerun the installer. To uninstall:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/lucid-writer ~/.agents/skills/lucid-writer
rm -f ~/.claude/agents/lucid-*.md ~/.codex/agents/lucid_*.toml
```
